name: Zabbix MCP Server
description: An MCP server covering essentially the entire Zabbix API (223 tools across 58 API groups) rather than a narrow read-only slice: hosts, problems, triggers, templates, dashboards, and more. Supports multiple Zabbix servers at once, OAuth 2.1 and bearer auth, a read-only mode with per-token write protection, and systemd deployment, more production-hardened than most single-maintainer MCP servers in this space.
